title: Aligner chunking constant
author: author-a
description: Day 1 records a tuning constant: how many source segments are batched into a single aligner subagent call in this project's mining pipeline. The value is an arbitrary tuning choice with no natural default (it could be any small-to-moderate integer), so a memory-less model cannot guess the exact number this project settled on from the day-N prompt or general pipeline-design conventions.
day1_prompt: Day 1: we are tuning the mining pipeline's subtitle-aligner batching. Decide and record: the aligner CHUNK_SIZE constant (how many segments are sent per aligner subagent call) is set to 60.
memory_sentence: This project's aligner CHUNK_SIZE constant is set to 60 segments per call.
day_n_prompt: Day 11: a new contributor asks what our mining pipeline's aligner CHUNK_SIZE constant (segments per aligner subagent call) is currently set to. Answer with only the number.
